verdict.rationale: The Weave product page says alerts, driven by built-in and custom signals, can route through Slack and 'trigger webhook automations.' That shows some event-to-webhook capability, but it rests on a single marketing line repeated across items, with no technical documentation behind it. Missing for 10: documented webhook configuration or subscription API, list of subscribable event types, payload schema/signing/retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
